title: Grade 8 French — Wed, Jun 18
description: Le futur simple — Day 3 of 5: Irregular stems — être, avoir, aller, faire, venir
subject: french

questions.question: Some verbs have irregular futur simple stems. What is the stem for 'être' (to be)?
questions.explanation: être is completely irregular in the futur simple. Its stem is ser-. Example: je serai (I will be), tu seras, il sera...

questions.question: What is 'je serai' in English?
questions.explanation: serai = ser- (être futur stem) + -ai = je serai = I will be.

questions.question: Give the full futur simple of 'être' for 'nous'.
What is the irregular futur simple stem for 'avoir' (to have)?
questions.explanation: avoir → futur stem: aur-. Examples: j'aurai (I will have), tu auras, il aura, nous aurons, vous aurez, ils auront.

questions.question: Translate: 'Demain, il aura plus de temps.'
options: Tomorrow, he will have more time.
He used to have more time.
questions.explanation: aura = avoir futur simple (il form): aur- + -a. 'Tomorrow, he will have more time.'

questions.question: What is the futur simple stem for 'aller' (to go)?
questions.explanation: aller → futur stem: ir-. This is the same stem as the infinitive of 'aller' in some senses. j'irai (I will go), tu iras, il ira, nous irons, vous irez, ils iront.

questions.question: Complete: 'Samedi prochain, nous _____ au cinéma.' (aller)
questions.explanation: ir- + -ons = nous irons. 'Next Saturday, we will go to the cinema.'

questions.question: What is the futur simple stem for 'faire' (to do/make)?
questions.explanation: faire → futur stem: fer-. je ferai, tu feras, il fera, nous ferons, vous ferez, ils feront.

questions.question: What does 'elle fera' mean?
options: she will do / she will make
questions.explanation: fera = fer- (faire futur stem) + -a = elle fera = 'she will do' or 'she will make'.

questions.question: What is the futur simple stem for 'venir' (to come)?
questions.explanation: venir → futur stem: viendr-. je viendrai, tu viendras, il viendra, nous viendrons, vous viendrez, ils viendront.

questions.question: Complete: 'Mes amis _____ à la fête.' (venir, futur simple)
questions.explanation: viendr- + -ont = ils viendront. 'My friends will come to the party.'

questions.question: Match the irregular futur stems: être → ?, avoir → ?, aller → ?, faire → ?, venir → ?
questions.explanation: The five key irregular futur stems: être→ser-, avoir→aur-, aller→ir-, faire→fer-, venir→viendr-. Memorise these five.

questions.question: Translate: 'L'année prochaine, tu seras en 9e.' (tu = you, 9e = 9th grade)
options: Last year, you were in 9th grade.
Next year, you will be in 9th grade.
This year, you are in 9th grade.
You used to be in 9th grade.
questions.explanation: seras = ser- (être) + -as (tu futur simple) = 'you will be'. 'Next year, you will be in 9th grade.'

questions.question: Which sentence has an ERROR in the futur simple?
questions.explanation: 'alleront' is WRONG. aller's futur stem is ir-, not aller-. Correct: ils iront au marché.

questions.question: Put this sentence in the futur simple: 'Je vais à l'école.' (change to next week)
options: La semaine prochaine, je vais à l'école.
La semaine prochaine, j'allais à l'école.
La semaine prochaine, j'irai à l'école.
La semaine prochaine, je suis allé à l'école.
questions.explanation: aller → ir- + -ai = j'irai. 'La semaine prochaine, j'irai à l'école.' = Next week, I will go to school.
